verification: CI unit fixtures: two generated compose projects (personal and swarm) rendered into temporary config roots; docker host view and compose invocations faked at the agentibrain.bootstrap seam. Mocked: no docker daemon or deployed brain was contacted.
assertions: Personal and swarm on distinct ports render compose projects agentibrain-personal and agentibrain-swarm with no container_name, disjoint published ports and project scoped volume names.
A second independent fixture on another port set renders the same shape from its own roots.
Every service URL in a named brain's environment names a service of the same project on its project network.
Starting both brains runs compose only in each brain's own config root, never runs down and never removes another stack.
A named brain resolves only its own config root, even when a kernel checkout is the cwd and Docker reports the default stack.
The default brain keeps its fixed agentibrain_* names, no project name and its legacy ports.
